landing_meta_title: GuaJi AI | Practice speaking with real-world AI voice scenarios
landing_meta_description: GuaJi AI gives language learners AI voice conversations, real-world scenario tasks, immediate feedback, and progress tracking for goal-based speaking practice.
landing_direct_answer: GuaJi AI is a browser-based speaking practice app. Set a target language and learning goal, complete real-world tasks through AI voice conversations, receive immediate feedback, and review your progress later.
landing_direct_point_1: Generate practice scenarios from your language, level, and goal.
landing_direct_point_2: Complete real-world scenario tasks through voice conversations.
landing_direct_point_3: Review feedback, task progress, conversation history, and recall material.
landing_faq_a1: GuaJi AI is a browser-based AI speaking practice app with voice conversations, real-world scenario tasks, immediate feedback, and progress tracking.
landing_faq_q2: Can I practice toward my own learning goal?
landing_faq_a2: Yes. Choose your target language, current level, learning goal, and voice; the app uses them to generate practice scenarios and tasks.
landing_faq_q3: What does the app record during practice?
landing_faq_a3: The app records task progress, conversation history, and learning performance so you can review completed scenarios and continue practicing.

privacy_body:
Last updated: June 17, 2026

GuaJi (the "App") respects and protects user privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

1. Information We Collect: At registration we collect your nickname, email, native language, and target language. During practice we process your voice and text input for real-time speaking assessment and feedback.

2. How We Use Information: Your voice/text is used solely to provide speaking-practice scoring, personalized learning plans, and conversation history review — never for other purposes.

3. Third-Party Services: This App uses Alibaba Cloud DashScope for speech recognition and synthesis, Stripe to process subscription payments (we do not store your card number), and Tawk.to for live customer support. When you use the support chat, your conversation may be collected and stored by Tawk.to.

4. Data Security: Account credentials are transmitted via secure httpOnly cookies, passwords are stored encrypted, and external resource access is validated against a domain allowlist.

5. Your Rights: You may modify your profile or delete your account at any time via in-app settings. Associated data is removed upon account deletion.

6. Contact Us: For questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach us through the in-app live support chat.
